en-GB.description:
Tyre Rescue helps customers book urgent mobile tyre help, puncture repair and tyre fitting from their phone.

Choose your tyre size or service, confirm your current location with Mapbox, see clear pricing, pay securely, and track your booking while the driver is on the way.

Features:
- Emergency call-out booking
- Mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair
- Location autocomplete and current-location support
- Booking tracking with live status updates
- Secure payment for real-world tyre services
- Account option after payment to view bookings and reuse customer details
- Help contact by phone, WhatsApp and email

Tyre Rescue serves Central Scotland and surrounding service areas. Availability, pricing and call-out fees depend on your selected service, location and distance.
en-GB.releaseNotes: Improved the booking experience with smoother animations, clearer booking choices, enhanced tracking feedback, and a quick copy option for booking references after confirmation. This update also includes minor stability and usability improvements.

en-GB.subtitle: Mobile Tyre Rescue

review.notes:
Sign-in is not required. Reviewers can create a booking without an account. After a successful booking/payment, the customer is offered an optional account so they can view bookings, tracking, invoices, and reuse their contact details.

To test payment, use Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future expiry date, any CVC, and any UK postcode.

The app uses Stripe only to collect payment for real-world mobile tyre repair, tyre fitting, and emergency roadside tyre services consumed outside the app. No digital content, subscriptions, credits, or app functionality are sold or unlocked. This payment flow follows App Review Guideline 3.1.3(e).

Location permission is requested only while the customer creates or tracks a booking. It is used to confirm the service address, check Tyre Rescue coverage, calculate distance-based pricing, show the driver route/ETA, and help the assigned driver reach the customer. The app does not request background location.

Push notifications are optional and are used only for booking/payment/driver-status updates, such as booking confirmation, driver assignment, and tracking progress. They are not used for advertising or marketing.

The Help tab provides phone, WhatsApp, and email contact: support@tyrerescue.uk.
